julia: Heads-up — trying to find the GPU dashboards for the KV cache hitrate and SM% per pod. Anyone have the links? Need screenshots for a perf postmortem.

karthik: @julia try the gpu-ops Grafana board — main panels: 'SM Utilization', 'KVCache Hitrate', 'Batch size distribution'. Link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gpu-ops?orgId=1 :point_up:

julia: I can see SM and KV panels but not the mem-per-process panel. I only see total GPU memory.

sam: Mem per process is on the 'model-debug' dash — panel 'GPU mem by process'. direct: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/model-debug?panel=7

julia: perfect. also where do I pull traces for a slow request? I have trace id `0x9c4a` but not sure how to map it back to a pod.

ops-bot: [alert] 2026-03-05T14:15Z high-kv-miss-rate on stack-redwood-prod — rule: kvcache_miss_rate > 0.2 for 5m

karthik: For traces use Jaeger at https://jaeger.redwood.ai — search by trace id `0x9c4a`. Spans include `instance_id` and `pod` tags so you can find the pod and timeline.

julia: thanks. quick Q on alert tuning — current KV miss alert is noisy during model rollouts. Can we suppress it for rollout windows?

sam: Yes. We add a rollout label during canaries (`deployment_rollout=1`). We could change the alert rule to ignore metrics with that label. Example suggestion below.

sam: ```yaml
# suggested: exclude rollouts from paging
- alert: HighKVCacheMiss
  expr: kvcache_miss_rate > 0.2
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache miss rate high"
  # exclude known rollouts (pseudo)
  expr: (kvcache_miss_rate > 0.2) unless (deployment_rollout == 1)
```

karthik: small nit: prometheus alert rules can't have two `expr` fields. Better to use a single expression that checks the rollout label, or add a recording rule. For example: ```expr: kvcache_miss_rate > 0.2 and on(job) (deployment_rollout != 1)``` — but boolean label checks can be finicky. I'll open a PR with a tested expression.

julia: awesome. can someone drop direct panel links I should screenshot for the postmortem? Need SM%, KV hitrate, batch size heatmap, and mem-per-process.

kevin: Short checklist + links:
- SM%: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gpu-ops?panel=3
- KV hitrate: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/gpu-ops?panel=5
- Batch size heatmap: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/throughput?panel=9
- Mem per process: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/model-debug?panel=7

I'll add screenshots to the postmortem doc.

julia: thanks all. @karthik when you open that PR ping me for review. I'll include the PR link in the postmortem notes.

karthik: PR drafted: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/infra-alerts/pull/187 — includes rule tweak + test cases.

julia: perfect. closing this thread — will update when postmortem is done :white_check_mark:
